$comment: A docs page that moved: its old name, its new. tools/deploy.sh answers the old address with a 308 to the new; tools/docs_site.py --check holds each new name to a page. A section that moved to another page while its page stayed is "page#anchor": a fragment never reaches the server, so the old page sends it on (tools/docs_site.py moved_here, web/docs.js).
